# Technical glossary

Quick reference for acronyms, parameters and recurring concepts in modules. The glossary works as a supporting layer for reading, without competing with the main sequence of the course.
:::

::: {.page-hero-aside}
**Recommended use**

Consult while reading the modules when a technical term appears outside its immediate context.
:::
:::

::: {.utility-flow}
::: {.utility-step}
**Read the term**

Use the glossary as quick support, not as a replacement for the module.
:::

::: {.utility-step}
**Compare usage**

Note whether the term appears as a concept, parameter, method or analysis output.
:::

::: {.utility-step}
**Apply to module**

Return to the main content to interpret the term in context.
:::
:::

::: {.utility-decision role="region" aria-label="How to turn a glossary term into study"}
::: {.utility-decision-copy}
**Term understood, context required**

The glossary solves the short definition. Learning happens when the term goes back to the module, to the script and to the interpretation of the output.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-grid role="list" aria-label="Ways to use a technical term"}
::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Definition**

Read the meaning and identify whether it is a parameter, method or result.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

Use search to find where the term appears in the trail.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Application**

Go back to the module and connect the term to the technical decision.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route role="navigation" aria-label="How to turn a definition into technical evidence"}
::: {.utility-evidence-route-copy}
**From definition to evidence**

A technical term only becomes useful when it returns to the course context. Choose the format in which the concept needs to be checked.
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-grid role="list" aria-label="Evidence routes after the glossary"}
::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

Use when the definition depends on script, simulation, or function argument.

[Open M01](modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 01 to review code evidence after the glossary"}
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Table**

Use when the term is a parameter, variance, correlation, or comparable measure.

[Open M06](modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 06 to review table evidence after the glossary"}
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Figure**

Use when the term appears in genomics, SNPs, GWAS, or prediction.

[Open M12](modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 12 to review visual evidence after the glossary"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-examples role="region" aria-label="How to read glossary terms"}
::: {.utility-examples-copy}
**Read the term for the role it occupies**

The same term can appear as a concept, parameter or output. Before returning to the module, identify what type of use is at stake.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-grid role="list" aria-label="Roles of technical terms"}
::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Concept**

Explain the biological or statistical question.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Parameter**

Quantifies variation, relationship or accuracy.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Output**

It needs to be interpreted together with the script and the module.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan role="region" aria-label="How to leave the glossary with a useful question"}
::: {.utility-query-plan-copy}
**Transform definition into return**

After reading a term, identify where it falls on the trail. The short definition only becomes learning when it goes back to the module, the script and the interpretation.
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-grid role="list" aria-label="Plan for using a glossary term"}
::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Sort**

Is it concept, parameter, method or output?
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Locate**

Use search if you need to find the term in modules.
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Apply**

Return to the section in which the term supports a decision.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-no-result role="region" aria-label="What to do when the glossary does not solve it"}
::: {.utility-no-result-copy}
**If the definition is not enough, return to context**

A technical term rarely resolves a decision alone. When the definition still seems loose, look for the usage in the module and script output.
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-grid role="list" aria-label="Adjustments when the glossary is not enough"}
::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Example**

Search for the term in the course to see concrete usage.

[Open search](search.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open course search"}
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Phase**

Return to the phase that introduces the concept.

[View modules](modules/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the module index"}
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Application**

Read the excerpt in which the term supports the decision.

[See roadmap](semanas/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the weekly roadmap"}
